records.quantity_needed: Complete annual event histories and sampling frame
records.why_needed: News reports omit unknown or uneventful years.
records.preferred_future_source: Representative multi-unit, multi-year training logs including zero-event years and coverage metadata.

records.quantity_needed: Rounds per identified crew per defined event
records.why_needed: Unit totals and crew counts do not establish allocation.
records.preferred_future_source: Linked ammunition expenditure, crew roster and event records.
records.impact_on_modeling: Blocks per-crew rate inference and multiplication of SME ranges.

records.population: Operators, crew, observers and safety personnel
records.why_needed: Presence cannot be derived from MOS or exercise participation alone.
records.preferred_future_source: Deidentified roster-to-range-log linkage with role and time.

records.quantity_needed: Annual teaching load and live-fire attendance
records.why_needed: Course duration does not specify instructor firing opportunities.
records.preferred_future_source: Instructor calendars, rotations and event attendance logs.

records.quantity_needed: Edition applicability, exceptions and qualification execution
records.why_needed: Historical validity and sustainment are not current compliance rates.
records.preferred_future_source: Public current manuals, supersession notices and scoped qualification records.
records.impact_on_modeling: Blocks current-policy constraints and compliance assumptions.

records.why_needed: Rounds fired are not automatically individual exposures.
records.preferred_future_source: Consented deidentified event rosters, synchronized sensors and configuration logs.
records.impact_on_modeling: Blocks individual counts, pressure and impulse reconstruction.

records.population: Army Active and National Guard, especially 13M
records.quantity_needed: Comparable annual histories with common denominators
records.why_needed: The indirect Guard SME recollection has no numeric rate.
records.preferred_future_source: Matched unit/year logs across components and explicit direct SME elicitation.

records.population: Marine Active and Reserve 0811, 0341 and HIMARS
records.quantity_needed: Comparable component histories and exact occupations
records.why_needed: A reserve example does not define all reserve tempo, and HIMARS MOS is unresolved.
records.preferred_future_source: Component-stratified exercise, qualification and occupation records.
records.impact_on_modeling: Blocks component contrasts and assumed 0811/0814 operational mappings.

records.population: Units and people across training cycles
records.why_needed: One exercise cannot reveal a yearly joint distribution.
records.preferred_future_source: Multi-year panels with deployment preparation, unit type and training-cycle identifiers.
records.impact_on_modeling: Blocks empirical variability and independence assumptions.

records.quantity_needed: Archived originals, exact passages and retrieval provenance
records.why_needed: Indexed-text review cannot reproduce original source bytes.
records.preferred_future_source: Permitted official archived publications and source-owner clarification of conflicts.
records.impact_on_modeling: Limits source verification; does not justify silently repairing contradictions.

records.quantity_needed: Session, mission, period and event boundaries
records.why_needed: SME period and event wording are not established as interchangeable.
records.preferred_future_source: Source-defined event logs and explicit structured elicitation with examples.
records.impact_on_modeling: Blocks combining annual periods with rockets per event.

records.quantity_needed: Assignment dates, transfers and unobserved years
records.why_needed: No participant histories are present; missing reports are not zero counts.
records.preferred_future_source: Authorized deidentified assignment intervals and observation-coverage indicators.
records.impact_on_modeling: Blocks duration prorating and missing-year imputation.

records.quantity_needed: Calibrated waveforms, orientation, position and event linkage
records.why_needed: Neither weapon identity nor gauge triggers alone yield validated exposure histories.
records.preferred_future_source: Releasable synchronized sensor/event datasets with QA, calibration and ammunition metadata.
records.impact_on_modeling: Blocks pressure/impulse attribution; provides no medical risk function.
